messages:
maria.dev: heads up — I'll kick a config-only deploy in 10m to tighten batching and add a slim per-route limiter. No model change.

sachin: ack. what's the plan for canary and rollback criteria? :eyes:

maria.dev: canary 5% for 15m across us-east, us-west. rollback triggers: error-rate +2% sustained OR p95 latency > 1200ms OR token drop rate up. i'll pin traffic and set explicit fallback to the older batching profile.

ops-lead: please add the rollout note to release-notes/ and confirm that dedicated pools are excluded.

maria.dev: yep excluded dedicated pools. adding note now.

maria.dev: config snippet:
```
routes:
  - name: /generate
    batching:
      mode: slim
      max_batch_size: 64
      max_latency_ms: 30
    rate_limit:
      per_minute: 3500
    timeout_ms: 800
fallback_policy: route_to_variant: stable-batching
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration_min: 15
```

nina.prod: please pin model-serving version on canary pods? last time a variant drifted and caused a mismatch.

maria.dev: good call — pinning to `serving-2.1.3` for the canary and `serving-2.1.2` for stable, documented in the rollout notes.

ryan.sdk: will update client SDK advise about the slightly lower default timeout in the SDK tests. not blocking.

deploy-bot: deploy started by maria.dev — config-only change — target=hosted, canary=5% — run id=cfg-2145006789

sachin: monitoring dashboards set: qps, p95 latency, error-rate, token-loss. alert threshold for p95 set to 1100ms so we'll catch before rollback.

deploy-bot: canary healthy at 5% after 7m — no errors flagged :thumbsup:

maria.dev: bump to 20% for another 10m if we see stable metrics? propose: step to 20 after 15m.

ops-lead: agree. let's not exceed 60% without +1 from infra.

maria.dev: noted. I'll make the release note: "Config-only: slim batching, per-route limiter, default timeout 800ms; canary pinned to serving-2.1.3" and add links to the change window.

sachin: thanks — keeping eyes on it. ping me on any blips.

maria.dev: thanks all. will report back after the 20% step. :rocket:
